mods.name: session-clock
mods.description: A band above the prompt with the wall clock and how long the session has run (14:05 · 1h 12m).

mods.name: branch-band
mods.description: A band above the prompt with the git branch and the count of changed files, refreshed after each Bash call and file edit.

mods.name: tool-counter
mods.description: A band above the prompt with your tool calls this session, the top three by tool (Bash 41 · Edit 18 · Read 12).

mods.name: error-meter
mods.description: A band above the prompt with how many tool calls failed this session (an error or a deny) and which tool failed last. Red from the first failure.

mods.name: model-badge
mods.description: A band above the prompt with the current model name and the context percent (opus-4-1 · 62%).

mods.name: dev-band
mods.description: The developer band in one row above the prompt: git branch and changed files, wall clock and session age, tool counts, and failed tool calls.
